title: 「森友」国有地を入札へ、時期は未定　取得希望の社会福祉法人は審査通らず
extracted_text: 学校法人「森友学園」の小学校用地だった大阪府豊中市の国有地について、国土交通省大阪航空局は1日、取得を希望した社会福祉法人が審査を通らず、売却先に決まらなかったと明らかにした。今後、一般競争入札での売却を予定している。 航空局によると、昨年10月から売却先の募集を始め、取得を希望した社会福祉法人から提出された事業計画の実現性などを審査したが要件を満たさなかった。今後の入札時期は未定で、国有地と建築会社が管理する建物をいずれも購入することを条件とする。
translated_text: Regarding the national land in Toyonaka City, Osaka Prefecture, which was the elementary school site for school corporation Moritomo Gakuen, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's Osaka Aviation Bureau revealed on the 1st that a social welfare organization that had hoped to acquire the land failed to pass screening, and no buyer was decided. In the future, it plans to sell the land through general competitive bidding. According to the Aviation Bureau, it began soliciting buyers from last October, and screened the feasibility of business plans submitted by the social welfare organization that wished to acquire the land, but the requirements were not met. The timing of the future bidding has not been decided, and the condition is that both the national land and the building managed by a construction company must be purchased.
title_en: National land of 'Moritomo' to be put up for bidding, timing undecided — Social welfare organization that hoped to acquire it fails screening
